svg.title: Doctoral awards by language
svg.desc: Distinct educational indicators, not border crossings or a count of all learners. Exact observations and provenance accompany this figure.

g.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
g.text: Nationwide IPEDS | Chinese, Japanese and Korean | academic year ending
NCES IPEDS; 50 states/DC, Title IV degree-granting institutions. First-major language/literature awards,
not enrollment. 2025 is provisional. Lines break at major coding in 2001 and at the switch from the old
doctoral category to research/scholarship doctorates in 2010.
